title: Authenticate European Star Cross compact descriptors
platforms: European ROM; retained Wine evidence and protected static source plan
changes: Authenticate two Star Cross compact descriptors and their existing bank and original caller.
validation: Protected unit 5inrm3__ verifies two 24-byte descriptors, 40 sampled unowned bytes, the existing bank, count two and the original caller and callback.
limitations: Static code and sampled addresses do not establish exact scene PCs, all consumers or guest index domains. Runtime integration, other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
